$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all design tokens (Stage 1: QW-1 + QW-2).
Consumed by: tailwind.config.js (via createRequire), buildMuiTheme.ts and
tokens.ts (via import, tsconfig resolveJsonModule=true), index.css mirrors
the semantic values as CSS custom properties (see header comment there).
MECHANISM for dark-mode-switchable semantic colors in Tailwind:
Semantic colors are exposed as 'rgb(var(--color-*) / <alpha-value>)'.
index.css defines the --color-* variables as 'R G B' triplets in :root
and overrides them under .dark. Utility classes therefore switch modes
automatically without dark: variants. Primitive scales stay static hex.
RULES:
- Raw hex values are ONLY allowed in primitives.*
- semantic.{light,dark} reference intent, never raw usage sites.
- Do not add page-specific one-off colors here.
SUB-SCALE NOTES (kept out of object bodies so Tailwind spreads stay clean):
radius:   sm/md/lg/xl. MUI shape.borderRadius = md (0.5rem).
shadows:  e0-e3 elevation; MUI maps e0->none, e1->low entries, e2->menus,
e3->dialogs.
motion:   durations in ms; easings as cubic-bezier. The reduced-motion
override lives in index.css and must stay.
spacing:  unit is the MUI spacing multiplier base (px); Tailwind keeps its
default 4px scale.

primitives.$comment: Primitive palette. Only place where raw hex is defined. brand == existing Tailwind 'primary' scale (kept identical for backward compat).

semantic.$comment: Intent-based tokens, resolved per color mode. Tailwind consumes these via rgb(var(--color-*)) CSS variables defined in index.css; MUI reads them directly from the matching mode branch.

typography.$comment: Type scale shared by Tailwind fontSize tuples and MUI typography variants. Sizes in px; lineHeight/letterSpacing as unitless or px strings.

fontFamily.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
fontFamily.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

spacing.$comment: unit = MUI spacing multiplier base (px). Stage 6a layout constants: pageGutter is the desktop page gutter (mobile uses smaller responsive steps in PageShell), sectionGap is the vertical rhythm between page sections, cardPad the inner padding of cards. Tailwind exposes these as px-page-gutter / gap-section-gap / p-card-pad utilities.
